examples.title: Rejected upgrade: OrderGuard #1 → #11
examples.summary: A pull request proposed replacing circuit #1 with #11. PinCheck found input 0x01 returns 0x01 from the current circuit and 0x00 from the candidate, both deployed processors confirmed it, and the required check failed.
examples.recorded: Captured by the GitHub check on 2026-11-17 and reproduced at the same block hash with PinCheck 0.2.0.

examples.title: Accepted upgrade: OrderGuard #1 → #2
examples.summary: A pull request proposed replacing circuit #1 with #2. Both circuits share a netlist, all 4 inputs match, and the check passed.
examples.recorded: Captured by the GitHub check on 2026-11-17 and reproduced at the same block hash with PinCheck 0.2.0.

examples.title: Wide circuit: Neon Reliquary #5 vs #7 (20 inputs)
examples.summary: Two different published chips with the same 20-input, 22-output interface. Not a proposed upgrade: this shows that PinCheck checks all 1,048,576 inputs of a production-size circuit and replays the first difference on X Layer.
